answer.value: Pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets; SFT/DPO data consist of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries; RLVR data consist of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries. Language: English.
quotes: These models are pre-trained on the Dolma 3 dataset and post-trained on the Dolci datasets.
- supervised fine-tuning on the Dolci-Think-SFT-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, chat, and general knowledge queries.
- reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards on the Dolci-Think-RL-7B dataset. This dataset consits of math, code, instruction-following, and general chat queries.
